sentence_stem: Although the early results looked very promising,
full_sentence: Although the early results looked very promising, the project was eventually cancelled.
acceptable_variants: the project was still cancelled in the end.
the company nevertheless stopped the project.

options.text: so the project received more funding.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result that follows naturally. 'Although' requires an outcome that contrasts with the promising start, so more funding does not fit.

options.text: the team was very pleased with the start.
options.why_wrong: This repeats the positive mood of the stem instead of giving the contrasting outcome that 'although' requires.

options.text: the results were recorded in a report.
options.why_wrong: This describes a neutral action and does not complete the contrast started by 'although'.

explanation: After 'although', the main clause must present an outcome that contrasts with the first part of the sentence. Learners sometimes choose a clause that continues the positive mood or describes a neutral action, which breaks the contrast. The correct option shows that the promising start did not lead to success.
translation: Chociaż wstępne wyniki wyglądały bardzo obiecująco, projekt został ostatecznie anulowany.
